d: We are looking for an HR Specialist through the Tamheer Program to support employee onboarding, hiring documentation, and daily HR activities.
q: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks.
r: Coordinate the onboarding process for new employees.
Collect and review hiring documents to ensure they are complete, accurate, and valid.
Follow up with new employees to obtain missing or updated documents.
Coordinate with the IT team to ensure laptops and other required assets are prepared and handed over to new employees.
Maintain organized and up-to-date employee files and records.
Assist with daily HR operations and administrative tasks.
Support employee records management and HR documentation.
Assist with other HR activities as needed.
Assist with candidate screening, and interview coordination.
Support recruitment activities and follow up with candidates when needed.
